Dear Colleagues,

I'm Andrej Srakar. I work on my second PhD in mathematical statistics (but I research mainly in theoretical mathematics, in particular probability theory). I'm employed at the AI department of the main and largest Slovenian research institute Jozef Stefan, where I work in particular on my ERC Consolidators Grant resubmission. I also teach as assistant professor at the School of Economics and Business, University of Ljubljana.

I'm very involved internationally in research activities, among other being a long years member of some leading committees and organization of the Royal Statistical Society, Bernoulli Society, Institute of Mathematical Statistics and FENStatS. I coordinate YoungStatS project of the Young Statisticians Europe initiative.

I presented my short communication also at the recent ICM 2026 in Philadelphia.

My main interest at Lean is formalization of theorems in various parts of probability theory, analysis, differential geometry, algebra and category theory. I hope for interesting discussions, collaborations and fun times here.
